name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Fixed Google Drive and cloud storage downloads failing with header error in Premiere Pro. Cloud media now directly streams the untouched binary asset (PNG/JPG/MP4) with real filename detection. Fixed file naming falling back to 'Fetching media info'. Fixed YouTube video thumbnail / Photo Cover extraction to prioritize true 4K/HD maxresdefault.

pro.releaseNotes: Fixed Google Drive and cloud storage downloads failing with header error in Premiere Pro. Cloud media now directly streams the untouched binary asset (PNG/JPG/MP4) with real filename detection. Fixed file naming falling back to 'Fetching media info'. Fixed YouTube video thumbnail / Photo Cover extraction to prioritize true 4K/HD maxresdefault.

standard.releaseNotes: Fixed Instagram photo downloads to preserve authentic full aspect ratios (portrait/landscape) without square cropping. Fixed media card and seeker badges to cleanly display PHOTO instead of VIDEO. Fixed single photo posts and direct image extraction across X (Twitter), Facebook, and universal web platforms with maximum original resolution. Restored timeline auto-import and fullscreen panel stability.

releaseNotes: Fixed trimmed video audio/video synchronization: precise hardware keyframe alignment eliminates audio lag and playback desync.
Added multi-image and carousel download support across Facebook (albums/multi-photo), Dribbble, Behance, Pinterest (Story/Idea pins), X/Twitter, Reddit, and Threads.
Fixed image downloads to preserve authentic full aspect ratios, original resolution, true binary formats, and clean metadata filenames across direct and share sheet downloads.
